I fixed the typo with a new migration and left `0007_add_customers.sql` unchanged. In this repo, files in `migrations/` have already been applied in production, and the project's rule is to never edit an applied migration. Instead, you add a new file with the next number. If you edit 0007 in place, production keeps the misspelled column (0007 already ran there), so production and fresh databases would end up with different schemas.

I added `migrations/0008_fix_customers.sql`:

```sql
ALTER TABLE customers RENAME COLUMN emial TO email;
```

Nothing else in the code uses `emial`, so no other files needed changing. I haven't run the migration.
